notes.title: About streaming
notes.content:
If you want to stream the game, you can stream it without any additional procedure.
 We would appreciate it if you could let us know of your streaming by email to the developer. (not required)

  Developer Email: youngleopardcat@gmail.com

notes.title: Bug fix and improvement
notes.content:
# Bug fix, @ Improvement

 # Fixed the issue where the puzzle would not be solved when attacking the button in the button input puzzle.
 # Fixed a part where can pass without solving the puzzle.
 # Fixed the issue where stuck in some robots.
 # Fixed incorrect lighting effects on some puzzles.
 # Fixed the issue where the robot's hand would no longer move when the obstacle was pushed.

 @ Improved to be able to see puzzles with collectibles.
 @ Adjusted the brightness of puzzles to make things more distinct.
 @ Improved to show the visual effect after the player has stunned and until they can stun again.
